name: Mysterious Cat
source:
“Even the cat can answer that question”

	The cat that resides in nameless mansion. Its purpose is to guide you to the room of question and help you to reclaim your memory.
	It has funny personality and often joke with you.

[spoiler]True identity of the cat is the girl who wait protagonist in the last room of nameless mansion.[/spoiler]
